questions.q: What drives the highlights panel shown at the top of a Lightning record?
options: The record's assigned page layout
The record's assigned compact layout — a separate, much shorter configuration
The record's related lists
The user's personal navigation settings
questions.explain: The lesson explains the highlights panel isn't driven by the page layout at all — it's a separate compact layout configuration.

questions.q: On Object Manager's Compact Layouts screen, what do Available Fields and Selected Fields control?
options: Which profiles can edit the object
Which fields appear in the highlights panel, and in what order
Which related lists appear on the full record page
Which business process applies to the record
questions.explain: Compact Layout Edit uses a dual-listbox: Available Fields on the left, Selected Fields on the right, with Add and reorder controls to set the highlights panel's field list and order.

questions.q: The lesson shows a Case's default highlights panel (Priority, Status, Case Number) and a custom one (Status, Case Number, Case Origin, Case Reason). Why did the panel change?
options: Because the page layout was edited
Because the record was converted to a different object
Because a different compact layout was assigned to the record
Because the user's profile changed
questions.explain: Swapping in a custom compact layout changes the highlights panel's field set immediately, independent of the page layout.

questions.q: According to the lesson, why do compact layouts stay deliberately small, even though there's no hard field limit enforced?
options: Because Salesforce charges extra per field added to a compact layout
Because the highlights panel has limited visual real estate, and a crowded panel defeats the point of a quick, at-a-glance summary
Because compact layouts can only ever contain exactly 3 fields
Because adding more fields breaks the page layout
questions.explain: The lesson argues that a panel crowded with many fields undermines the goal of letting a user recognize what matters about a record at a glance.

questions.q: What is the relationship between a compact layout and the full page layout on the same record?
options: They are the same configuration, just displayed differently
The compact layout is a short, separate summary; the page layout is the full record detail — they are configured independently
The compact layout always contains every field from the page layout
Editing the page layout automatically updates the compact layout
questions.explain: A compact layout and a page layout are independent, separately configured pieces — one drives the highlights panel summary, the other drives the full record detail.
